name: card-field
title: Card Field
description: A single-row checkout field for card number, expiry and security code. The number groups as you type, then collapses to its last four so the other fields fit beside it.
use: A checkout needs the card number, expiry and code in one compact row.
avoid: The test-card helper and hardcoded zinc palette suit demos; real payment handling still needs a processor.
a11y: Fields are labelled and announce brand and payment state; motion respects reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a small Card heading, a Use test card link and one inset row with a brand badge, grouped digits, MM / YY and CVC, plus a hint line and a wide pay button below.
behaves: Typing digits groups the number in fours, and a valid full number slides away to its last four while expiry and security code appear in the same row. The pay button shifts from a dim idle tone to white once the form is complete.
customise: Amount, currency, a payment callback and test mode are props; the card layout, brand detection and colour palette are written in the source.
weight: light: A single card row with a few motion values; no loop and no heavy drawing.
